notes: Four new strategy tests in the Backtest tab, each with rules fixed in advance and a PASS/FAIL result: insider clusters and CEO/CFO buys, earnings drift after big earnings beats, momentum (last year's winners), and trend following across stocks, bonds, gold and real estate.
Backtests now use prices adjusted for stock splits and dividends. Before, a split could look like a crash or a huge gain. Please re-run your swing backtest: results may change a little.
Live trading is only added for strategies that pass.
